findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Direct unsafe XML parsing
 * @description Finding direct usage of xml.etree or lxml without defusedxml, excluding the xml abstraction layer.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/direct-unsafe-xml
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Location loc
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.etree.ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml.etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall()
  )
  and loc = call.getLocation()
  and not loc.getFile().getRelativePath().matches("openpyxl/xml/%")
select call, "Direct unsafe XML parsing detected outside of XML abstraction layer."
findings.hypothesis: Openpyxl might be using unsafe XML parsers directly, bypassing any safety mechanisms in openpyxl/xml/.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure lxml configuration
 * @description Checks for lxml parsers configured to allow network access or entity resolution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-lxml-config
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["XMLParser", "HTMLParser"]).getACall() and
  (
    call.getArgByName("resolve_entities").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true or
    call.getArgByName("no_network").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = false
  )
select call, "lxml parser configured with insecure options (resolve_entities=True or no_network=False)."
findings.hypothesis: lxml parser is configured insecurely allowing XXE.
